description:
Check a lock WITHOUT trying to take it, and tell "nobody ever took it"
    apart from "someone took it and released it" — a free lock and an
    already-finished task look identical from aanet_acquire_lock alone. Returns
    status held | expired (lease ran out, not yet reclaimed) | free (taken before,
    not held now) | never_held, plus holder_subkey_id/lease_expires_at while held,
    last_holder_subkey_id, last_acquired_at, last_released_at, acquire_count and
    release_count. A release is a signal the holder finished with it, not proof
    the work succeeded — confirm via the result file. 1 unit; a name nobody ever
    acquired is a free miss.

api_key.description: Bearer credential for this workspace: either the owner_key returned once by aanet_create_workspace/aanet_create_trial_workspace, or a sub-key returned by aanet_mint_subkey. Sent under the hood as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Owner-only tools reject a sub-key with a 403.
